feature_definitions.normalization: Unicode NFKC and lowercase lexical matching

response_only_ablation.context: empty string to preserve the shipped two-feature PCIB representation

falsifiability_score.rule: existing PCIBProbe falsifiability score with actual bounded context

max_answer_source_sentence_overlap.rule: maximum response-content overlap against one bounded source sentence

missing_or_empty_source.rule: one for missing or whitespace-only context, else zero

normalized_content_token_overlap.rule: unique response content words in context divided by response content words

normalized_number_token_overlap.rule: unique response numbers in context divided by unique response numbers

numeric_novelty_with_context.rule: unique response numbers absent from context divided by unique response numbers
